title: # [Playtest] JUICE: A 3D browser survival driving sim where you pilot a sentient smartphone across a giant house (Free / No Install / Mobile & PC)
author: PossessionNervous720
selftext:
\[Playtest\] JUICE: A 3D browser survival driving sim where you pilot a sentient smartphone across a giant house (Free / No Install / PC & Mobile)

Hey everyone! I’m looking for testers for \*\*JUICE\*\*, a 3D open-world survival driving simulation playable directly in your web browser (no download or login needed).

🎮 \*\*Play directly here:\*\*  

https://castawaygames.itch.io/juice

\*(Tip: On desktop, hit \[F\] or tap ⛶ Fullscreen / 🚀 Pop Out Tab for edge-to-edge play).\*

\---

\### 📱 What is JUICE?

In \*JUICE\*, human household scale is scaled up to continental proportions (1 cm ≈ 1 in-game meter). You pilot a sentient, wheeled smartphone crawler—a 6.7-inch titanium-and-glass slab fitted with micro-crawler wheels, exposed copper suspension, and a live 60FPS OLED dashboard.

The game runs on the \*\*Principle of Equality\*\*:  

\> \*\*Movement ≡ Energy Expenditure ≡ Life Depletion\*\*

Your Lithium-Ion battery percentage (0.0% to 100.0%) is your \*\*health pool, propulsion fuel, and economic currency\*\*. If your battery hits 0.00%, your cell enters terminal Cold Shutdown. Every meter driven, every steep ramp climbed, and every surface crossed extracts a physical energy toll:

\- \*\*Linoleum Tile:\*\* Slick and fast with low rolling resistance (μ = 0.04)—perfect for high-speed drifting.

\- \*\*Shag Carpet Savanna:\*\* Dense fibers create intense mechanical drag (μ = 0.22) that drains your battery up to 3x faster.

\- \*\*Hardcover Book Ramps:\*\* Gravity opposes you on 15°–22° inclines; descent allows regenerative braking to reclaim free wattage.

\---

\### 🕹️ Three Game Modes in One

When you open the game, you'll see a quick animated video preview showcasing all three modes (or hit \*\*Skip\*\* to jump straight to the launcher):

1. \*\*Mode 1: Drift Infinity (Arcade Endless Survival)\*\*  

   Survive as long as you can across the domestic wilderness! Drift over glowing Qi Wireless Boost Mats, dodge the autonomous patrol vacuum (ROOMBA-X900), harvest copper and IC chips, and use interactive cockpit modules (\`Magnet Pull\`, \`Sonar Ping\`, and \`Kernel Overclock\`).

2. \*\*Mode 2: Phonic Circuitry (Learn • Practice • Read)\*\*  

   An educational STEM/reading lab with crystal-clear voice synthesis and warm kalimba chimes. Tap to sound out Onsets and Rimes, drive through 3D Sound Gates (\`V-\` + \`-OLT\` = \`VOLT\`), and open the interactive Decodable Storybook with word-by-word tap-to-read audio and comprehension rewards.

3. \*\*Mode 3: Triad Chronicles (5-Act Story Campaign)\*\*  

   Follow your car's live OLED GPS compass across a 5-act narrative RPG. Negotiate with three rival factions:

   \- \*\*Clan 333 (The Drifters):\*\* Nomadic scavengers balancing voltage and kinetic freedom.

   \- \*\*Clan 404 (The Glitch):\*\* Swollen-battery raiders who fire parasitic harpoon tethers (counter them with your \`⚡ SHUNT\` capacitor dump!).

   \- \*\*Clan 777 (The Tethered):\*\* High-voltage aristocrats bolted permanently to 100W wall transformer sockets.

\---

\### 🎮 Controls & Hardware Support

\- \*\*Desktop (Keyboard / Mouse / Gamepad):\*\*  

  \- Drive: \`WASD\` or Arrow Keys  

  \- Boost: \`Spacebar\` | Regen Brake: \`Shift\` | Capacitor Shunt: \`E\`  

  \- Fullscreen: \`F\` | Camera View: \`C\` | Pause/Garage: \`ESC\`  

  \- Mouse: Click-drag to orbit 360°, scroll wheel to zoom (double-click to reset)  

  \- Gamepad: Plug-and-play USB/Bluetooth controller support with dual-rumble haptics  

\- \*\*Mobile (Phone / Tablet):\*\*  

  \- 360° Analog Steering Wheel thumbpad or Classic 4-Way D-Pad  

  \- Touch action pedals (Boost, Brake, Shunt)  

  \- Mobile Gyroscope Tilt-to-Steer (toggle \`📲 Tilt Steer\` in the cockpit)  

  \- Hardware Vibration API + Sub-Bass tactile impulse feedback  

  \- Pinch-to-zoom camera  

\---

\### 🧪 What I'm Looking for Feedback On:

1. \*\*Device & Browser Performance:\*\* Does it run smoothly at 60 FPS in 3D WebGL on your device? If 3D is unsupported, does the high-performance 2D canvas fallback kick in cleanly?

2. \*\*Audio & Voice:\*\* How is the audio balance between the whisper-quiet electric motor hum and spoken voice audio?

3. \*\*Steering & Physics:\*\* How does driving feel when transitioning between kitchen tile, shag rug, and incline ramps?

4. \*\*General Polish / Bugs:\*\* Any UI cutoffs, text overlaps, or weird edge cases?

\---

\### 🤖 AI Coding Disclosure

In the spirit of complete transparency with the dev community:

\- \*\*Concept, Game Design & Lore:\*\* The core game concept, "phone-in-a-giant-world" vision, narrative campaign, faction lore (Clans 333/404/777), mathematical framework (OEM Walls Triadic Reasoning Framework), and game design document were conceived, directed, and authored by Kip / Castaway Productions LLC.

\- \*\*Code & Implementation Assistance:\*\* Large Language Model AI tools were utilized as an engineering assistant to help write, optimize, and debug the single-file HTML5/JavaScript implementation (Three.js 3D rendering pipeline, Web Audio API procedural synthesis, DOM auto-fit scaling, and touch/gyro event handlers).

\---

Thanks so much for taking the time to test! Drop your feedback, device specs, or high scores below.
